spec_provided_observability.purpose: Type 3 device mailbox exposes status, health, and event-log records (informational / warning / failure / fatal).

spec_provided_observability.name: Coherency channel monitor

error_detection_mechanisms: Flit CRC (CXL.cache + CXL.mem) — detects corrupted Flits; triggers link-layer retry.
Forward Error Correction (PCIe 6.0 PHY for CXL 3.0) — corrects symbol errors before the link layer.
CXL.io inherits the full PCIe error framework (LCRC/ECRC, NAK+replay, AER).
Poison indication — propagates known-bad data so consumers can mark it invalid.
Viral indication — fatal-error containment that quiesces dependent agents.
CXL.mem uncorrectable memory error — reported to host via S2M response status.

interrupt_or_event_sources.trigger: Correctable / uncorrectable error on CXL.cache / CXL.mem / CXL.io.
Type 3 device posts an event-log record (health change, media error).
Fatal error sets viral state; propagated to dependent agents.

notes: CXL specifies a RAS framework (CXL RAS Capability registers, poison, viral) plus a Type 3 device mailbox + event-log mechanism. The PCIe PHY-level observability (loopback, compliance pattern, AER for CXL.io) is inherited from the underlying PCIe base spec. JTAG/scan/BIST remain integrator concerns.
